title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues the construction, from the previous pages, of an auxiliary group scheme M_{ρ,σ} attached to a group G (apparently a GL-type group with centre G_m, special subgroup SG and adjoint quotient PG) and to two 'sections' ρ, σ. On the previous page M_{ρ,σ} sits in an exact sequence 1 → SG → M_{ρ,σ} → T_{ρ,σ} → 1 (114). Here T_{ρ,σ} is a diagonalizable/torus-like group that embeds in T_0 × T_ρ × N'_σ (109). The defining relation is δ_0(u) = δ_σ(b) = ε'·δ_ρ(a) with ε'^2 = 1. There are characters χ, ε_3, ε_1 (110), and a homomorphism Θ: M_{ρ,σ} → G (111).

This page (115) records the composite morphisms obtained from description (102):
- M_{ρ,σ} → T_{ρ,σ} → T_ρ (first projection);
- T_{ρ,σ} → N'_σ → G_m (second projection followed by det);
- T_{ρ,σ} → μ2 × μ2 (the sign characters ε).

Grothendieck then makes a methodological remark. None of this construction used the actual sections ρ, σ of G, nor any knowledge of G beyond the existence of such sections, which enters only through the definition of T_ρ and N'_σ. However, finer structures on M_{ρ,σ} do depend on ρ and σ. His example is the family of 'n-groupes sections' M_{ρ,σ}(n), and he suggests these finer structures might allow one to recover ρ and σ.

A Remark follows. The cube (96) is the 'composite' of two cubic diagrams. Only the first has been made explicit, as a completion of (95), which may be seen as a partial diagram of it. The second cube (116) is given on the next page. Its top and bottom faces involve SR, R, M^+, M and their ° variants, and its vertical arrows are μ2×μ2-torsors.

The purpose seems to be bookkeeping of extension structures (G_m-, μ2×μ2- and PG-extensions) around the group M_{ρ,σ}. These serve the study of the 'équation des lacets', presumably groups and extensions attached to braid / Teichmüller-type relations with involutive generators. The exact meaning of ρ, σ and G cannot be pinned down from this page alone.
errors: No mathematical claim is checkable in isolation. The statement that the construction does not depend on ρ, σ beyond their existence is plausible given (109)-(110), where only T_ρ, N'_σ, δ and ε data enter.

ideas.what: Composite morphisms from M_{ρ,σ} via T_{ρ,σ} to T_ρ, G_m (via det on N'_σ) and μ2×μ2
ideas.modern_name: characters/projections of an extension of a diagonalizable group scheme

ideas.what: Observation that the abstract group M_{ρ,σ} is independent of the chosen sections ρ, σ, while finer structure (the 'n-group sections' M_{ρ,σ}(n)) depends on them and might recover them
ideas.modern_name: rigidification / recovering data from extra structure on an extension

ideas.what: Decomposition of the cube diagram (96) into two cubic diagrams with cartesian lateral faces and μ2×μ2 vertical torsors
ideas.modern_name: cubes of cartesian squares of group extensions

missed.claim: Grothendieck suggests that the sections ρ, σ might be recovered from finer structure on M_{ρ,σ} (the n-group sections M_{ρ,σ}(n)). The question is left open. It is a minor, context-specific open point within his own construction.
missed.quote: Mais des structures supplémentaires plus délicates dans M_{ρ,σ} - telle la donnée des n-groupes sections M_{ρ,σ}(n) - en dépendent, et permettent peut-être de les retrouver.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Only relevant if the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets' programme were reconstructed. Little independent significance.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine bookkeeping page: composite morphisms plus a remark about the structure of diagrams within an internal construction. There is no standalone new result or connection.
transcription_corrections: Use script letters 𝓜_{ρ,σ} and 𝒯_{ρ,σ} (as on the previous page), not plain M and T.
In (115), all three arrows issue from 𝒯_{ρ,σ}: pr_1 to T_ρ, pr_2 to N'_σ then det to G_m, and a third arrow to μ2×μ2. The first line reads 𝓜_{ρ,σ} → 𝒯_{ρ,σ}.
'(sauf dans T_ρ, N'_σ [-sont-] ...)' should read approximately 'dans T_ρ, N'_σ obtenus à partir de telles sections', with an interlinear insertion above (possibly 'on a ici').

'La cube' should read 'Le cube (96) est le "composé" de deux diagrammes cubiques, dont je n'ai explicité, dans le premier, ... complété (95) - qui peut être considéré comme un diagramme partiel de celui-ci'.
The 'Remarque' is written as an underlined abbreviation 'Rmq'.
